title: Add VPC control-plane Terraform: cross-account peering, Route53, interface endpoints, SGs
author: Priya Raman
description: Add Terraform modules and example stacks for provisioning the private control-plane VPC with support for cross-account VPC peering, Route53 private hosted zone delegation, interface endpoints, and security group templates. Motivation: customers deploying Redwood Private across accounts (management/control vs tenant) need first-class, repeatable infra for peering, DNS delegation (Route53 resolver rules / shared private hosted zones), and consistent endpoint+SG configuration. This PR introduces: 1) terraform/modules/vpc-control-plane: main VPC module with multi-az subnets, public/private split, NAT/GW choices. 2) terraform/modules/peering: cross-account peering module with optional route propagation and automated route table updates. 3) terraform/modules/route53-delegation: creates Private Hosted Zone, creates role for cross-account zone association, and optional resolver rules. 4) terraform/modules/interface-endpoints: VPC interface endpoint definitions for SSM/EC2/ECR/SecretsManager used by the private installer, with per-environment SGs. 5) example stacks under examples/private-control-plane-cross-account showing two-account deploy (control-plane account + tenant account), with outputs and a recommended workflow for creating the cross-account IAM role used for zone association. Changes include security hardening: least-privilege IAM policies for zone association, default-deny SG templates and explicit egress for required AWS service endpoints, and idempotent peering lifecycle hooks to support safe upgrades/rollback. The description below includes a checklist, testing notes, and rollout guidance. Checklist: - [x] Module unit tests (terraform validate + fmt) - [x] Cross-account association doc + example IAM role - [x] Integration test (local) for peering + resolver association - [x] Add smoke test to perf-canary for endpoint reachability - [x] Update private-installer Helm chart values reference Notes on upgrade/rollback: the peering module is additive and will not replace existing routes; route table attachments are applied only when peering_status == ACTIVE to avoid transient blackholes. For rollback, destroy is gated by a 'force_destroy_peering' boolean. Related Linear: ENG-4762 (vpc-private-control-plane), ENG-4781 (terraform-modules), OPS-219 (cross-account DNS).
